audience: venue teams that manage bookable spaces and bookings in Skedda

useCases.title: See which spaces exist at the venue
useCases.text: List the bookable spaces, assigned spaces and add-ons, filtered by category. Pass the paging cursor to read the next page.

useCases.title: List the bookings of a room for one week
useCases.text: List the booking occurrences in a window of up to 31 days. Recurring bookings appear once for each date.

useCases.title: Find bookings changed since yesterday
useCases.text: List the booking occurrences with the last-modified filter. Date-times need a UTC offset, such as +02:00.

useCases.title: Open the details of one booking
useCases.text: Get one booking occurrence by its booking ID and start date. Take both values from a list result.
